Lemma
[Laplacian in local coordinates, Christoffel form]

↗ lem:hessian-symmetric ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection

In any coordinate chart, the Laplacian of a smooth function $f$ satisfies \[ \triangle f = g^{ij}\left(\partial _i\partial _jf-\Gamma ^k_{ij}\partial _kf\right) = g^{ij}\partial _i\partial _jf+b^k\partial _kf, \qquad b^k:=-g^{ij}\Gamma ^k_{ij}, \] where $(g^{ij})$ is the inverse of the Gram matrix $(g_{ij})$ of the metric in the chart and $\Gamma ^k_{ij}$ are the Christoffel symbols of the Levi-Civita connection.

Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection

Trace the coordinate Hessian formula $\Hess (f)_{ij}=\partial _i\partial _jf-\Gamma ^k_{ij}\partial _kf$ with $g^{ij}$. Metric compatibility and differentiation of the inverse matrix convert the contracted Christoffel term into the stated derivatives of $g^{ij}$ and $\det g$, giving the divergence-form expression.

□
